tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Fraud threats in EMEA are intensifying. Confirmed by MarketScreener: 36% of organizations report over 25% increase in fraud attempts.
Anthropic launches academy, invests $100 million to train 10,000 artificial intelligence engineers. Reported by TechGig: the initiative aims to develop talent by 2027.
Sam Altman has split with Anthropic over artificial intelligence regulation and public access policies. Reported by citybiz.
Zhejiang University proposes a draft artificial intelligence law with developer and provider liability requirements. Reported by MLex: the proposal targets high-risk sectors.
Anthropic enables local inferencing in India for Claude artificial intelligence models via Amazon Bedrock. Reported by The Economic Times: the rollout brings models closer to users.
Free every hour.
